WITH MarriedMenByRegion AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.marital_status IN ('متزوج', 'متزوجة') AND d.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS total_married_men,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN d.marital_status = 'زوجتين' AND d.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS men_with_multiple_wives
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.id = hl.id
    WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'
      AND d.death_date IS NULL
      AND TRIM(hl.region) != ''
      AND hl.district IS NOT NULL 
      AND hl.district NOT IN ('خارج حدود الاحياء', 'بدون اسم')
    GROUP BY hl.region
),
MarriageRatioByRegion AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        total_married_men,
        men_with_multiple_wives,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_married_men > 0 THEN (men_with_multiple_wives * 100.0) / total_married_men
            ELSE 0
        END AS polygamy_ratio
    FROM MarriedMenByRegion
)
SELECT 
    region,
    polygamy_ratio
FROM MarriageRatioByRegion
ORDER BY polygamy_ratio DESC LIMIT 20000;
